description: This file defines the Legend class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, handling chart legend positioning, layout, and appearance customization.

classes.name: Legend
classes.description: Represents a chart legend with position, overlay, layout, border, and color properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Legend object with default or specified position, layout, and overlay options.

methods.name: getFillColor
methods.description: Returns the fill color of the legend.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current position of the legend as an Excel string value.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the legend position using an Excel string value.

methods.name: getPositionXL
methods.description: Retrieves the legend position as an Excel internal numeric value.

methods.name: setPositionXL
methods.description: Sets the legend position using an internal Excel numeric value.

methods.name: getOverlay
methods.description: Checks if overlay of other elements is allowed.

methods.name: setOverlay
methods.description: Sets whether overlay of other elements is permitted.
